objective: Define the scoped run boundary that may turn reviewed sidecar-launcher invocation fixture metadata and structured argv into a native-path launcher invocation attempt, without executing that run in this gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted invocation fixture proves only that reviewed metadata can materialize launcher argv. A later run may still fail when starting the launcher, inside a sidecar stage, or during coverage-output compare, so materialized argv must not be treated as native-path execution evidence.
reason: the previous review accepted define_sidecar_launcher_invocation_fixture only as metadata
the next useful step is defining exactly when a later run may start the existing sidecar launcher from the native path
coverage_output_equivalence remains the only scoped correctness policy after a future native-path run reaches compare

reports: scoped sidecar launcher invocation stdout/stderr summary
optional native-path launcher argv handoff summary
artifacts: raw state dumps used by compare

failure_class_boundary.process_parse_failure: the Verilator-facing process rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: native parser, bridge metadata, or invocation metadata exists but target/template/shape/source context is missing or ambiguous
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_authority_failure: reviewed bridge, invocation fixture, or stage authority is absent or mismatched for pulp_ita_mha 64x1
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_launcher_invocation_failure: the future run attempts to start the existing launcher from structured argv but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the sidecar launcher starts, but a scoped build/run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_invocation_run_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the future run boundary is narrow enough for a first native-path sidecar-launcher invocation attempt from structured argv
whether the boundary correctly distinguishes launcher invocation failure, sidecar stage failure, and compare failure
whether materialized argv remains metadata until a later run starts the launcher
whether generated reports and artifacts remain noncanonical
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain out of scope

non_claims: not native-path sidecar launcher invocation evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
